name: Cagsawa Festival
dateRule: Every February, month-long — opens 1 February, the anniversary of the 1814 eruption
venue: Cagsawa Ruins Park and the town proper
summary: A month-long celebration of Albayano resilience — not of the disaster — opening every 1 February at Cagsawa.
long:
The Cagsawa Festival began in 2012. The 2014 "Cagsawa Dos Siglos" edition marked the eruption's bicentennial, and 2024 marked 300 years since the Cagsawa church was rebuilt. The 2026 festival (1–28 February) opened with the unveiling of Cagsawa's National Cultural Treasure marker.

The programme typically includes a grand opening night and concert, a street-dance competition, the Mutya & Ginoo ng Cagsawa pageant, the Kalaga culinary contest, the Cagsawa Trail Run, motocross, 4×4 enduro and mountain-bike events, a music festival and trade fairs. 2026 also saw the first "Queen of DaraGayña: Battle of the Queens", with 20 candidates.
highlights: Queen of DaraGayña: Battle of the Queens
Cagsawa Trail Run, motocross, 4×4 enduro and MTB

name: Daraga Town Fiesta — Feast of Nuestra Señora de la Porteria
dateRule: 8 September every year, with a novena beforehand
summary: The feast of Daraga's patroness, Our Lady of the Gate — Masses, a procession, parades, cultural shows and food bazaars.
long:
Daraga honours its patroness, Nuestra Señora de la Porteria (Our Lady of the Gate), every 8 September, preceded by a novena. Expect Masses, a procession, street parades, cultural shows and food bazaars.

In 2023, Mayon's unrest disrupted the fiesta and activities were consolidated on 8 September. The LGU noted September 2025 as the 250th celebration of the patroness.
